title: Operation
description: Server-side idempotency dedup record. Stored for 30 days minimum (implementations MAY retain longer). Client supplies operation_id (UUIDv7) on every mutating verb. Server caches the response and replays it for any retry within retention.

operation_id.description: UUIDv7 (time-ordered) supplied by the client. Implementations MUST NOT generate operation_ids server-side.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON form of the request body (UTF-8, sorted keys, no whitespace). Used to detect operation_id reuse with different payloads, which MUST return 409 Conflict.

response_body.description: Cached response body, returned verbatim on retry. Implementations MAY omit this field from external representations of Operation; it is shown here for clarity.

expires_at.description: Earliest time the server may purge this operation. After expiry, retries return 410 Gone.
